resources.string: Helper that describes the screen and buttons

Baseerat uses this accessibility service to show the floating button, take a screenshot to describe it, name buttons and listen for the volume-key gestures you choose. Everything is processed on your phone; nothing leaves the device.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Baseerat service is off. Turn it on to describe screens and use the floating button and volume shortcuts. Camera, gallery and chat work without it.
To describe any app\'s screen, turn on the floating button and tap it.
The screen will be described in 5 seconds. Switch to the app you want now.
First turn on the Baseerat service in Accessibility settings.
How to turn the service on
1. Press \"Open accessibility settings\" below.\n2. Open \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed services\" and choose Baseerat.\n3. Turn the switch on and accept the permission.

If the switch is dimmed (Android 13 or newer): open app info, use the three-dot menu at the top and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again. Android does this for apps installed from an APK file.
Delete all saved results? This cannot be undone.

Offline answers about objects, text, colors and number of people. For full-sentence answers a large model is needed.
There is also text in the image.
Nothing clear could be recognized. Try better light or move closer.
Note: the imported model could not run, so the built-in model was used.
No text was found in the picture.

No face was detected in the picture.
Yes, \"%1$s\" is probably in the picture (confidence %2$d%%).
I can answer basic questions offline: objects, text, colors and number of people. Full-sentence answers need a large model. Summary of the picture: %1$s
Point the camera at the object, then press the big button or a volume key.
Point the camera at the text, then press the big button or a volume key.
Camera is ready. Press a volume key or the Take photo button.
The camera could not be started. Close it and try again.
Camera permission is needed to take pictures.
Off by default while TalkBack is running, so two voices do not talk at once. You can turn it on any time.
Also tells the text, people positions and more objects.
Vibrate when a result is ready
Only text is saved, never pictures, and it stays on this phone.
Engine, language, voice, speed, pitch and test
Size, position, click behavior, volume keys
Pictures and screen content are analyzed entirely on your phone and are never sent to the internet. The internet is used only when you yourself press a model download button.
Needs the accessibility service. The button stays on top of every app.
Drag the button anywhere with your finger; it snaps to the nearest edge and remembers its place. With TalkBack use the button\'s actions menu or the buttons below.
Other way: add the Baseerat tile to Quick Settings. Chat, camera and the other actions can also be chosen above.
Baseerat — what would you like to do?
List all buttons on the screen
The screen picture could not be taken. It may be a protected screen, or the phone is older than Android 11.
The screen picture could not be taken, so here is the screen text instead:
No focused item found. First move the screen-reader focus to a button or item on the screen, then try again.
%1$s: no name, and its picture could not be taken.
Note: %1$d buttons have no name. Choose \"Buttons and their names\" from the menu to find out what they are.
No tappable item was found on this screen.
The screen content could not be read. Open an app screen and try again.
%1$d tappable items on the screen, %2$d have no name.
The text-to-speech engine could not start. Install or enable an engine in the phone\'s TTS settings.
The chosen language is not available in this engine. Press \"Install voice data\" below or choose another engine.
Test text (leave empty for a sample)
Use these to install new voices or engines. Come back to this screen afterwards.
یہ بصیرت کی آواز کا ٹیسٹ ہے۔ آپ کو یہ آواز کیسی لگی؟
This is a voice test for Baseerat. How does this voice sound?
Import or download offline models here. Three kinds of files work: Tesseract .traineddata (Urdu / Arabic / English OCR), .tflite image-classification models (objects) and .task chat models.
Uses Tesseract when Urdu/Arabic data is installed, otherwise ML Kit.
Urdu and many languages, but slower. Needs a data file to be installed.
This build does not include the Tesseract engine, so Urdu OCR is switched off and ML Kit (English) is used. The build log shows whether Tesseract was found (see BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS).
No Tesseract data is installed yet. To read Urdu text, download or import \"urd\" below.
Choose a .traineddata, .tflite or .task file from your phone. It is copied into the app (large files take a while).
Each model is downloaded once and then works offline forever. Links can change; if one fails, download the file from the web pages below and import it.
Your own link: any https link ending in .traineddata, .tflite or .task.
Open these pages in the browser, download a file and import it above.
Not supported yet: GGUF, ONNX and picture-seeing (VLM) models. Chatting about a picture works from the facts the detector found (objects, text, colors, people), not from the pixels.
%1$s is not supported. Only .traineddata, .tflite and .task / .bin (chat) files work.
Tesseract urd.traineddata — a few MB, the first step for reading Urdu text.
Tesseract eng.traineddata — better for text mixed with Urdu.
urd.traineddata from tessdata_best. Replaces the fast version; more accurate but slower.

On the Home screen press \"Describe with camera\" or \"Choose from gallery\". The result is shown as text and can be spoken. To describe the screen of other apps, first turn on the Baseerat service in Accessibility.

The floating button stays above every app. In Settings > Floating button choose what a tap and a long press do (default: menu / describe the screen). Drag it anywhere. With TalkBack, use the button\'s actions menu to move it.

For each volume button choose separately what pressing it twice and holding it does (describe the screen, name the focused button, read text, chat and more). Keys left on \"Nothing\" work as normal volume keys. In the camera the volume keys take the picture. The Quick Settings tile also opens the menu.

\"Name the focused button / item\" tells about ONLY the item TalkBack is on: its name, type and state; if it has no name it guesses from its picture. \"List all buttons\" lists every tappable item of the whole screen. Guesses can be wrong: double-check important buttons (payments etc.).
Go to Settings > Models and OCR and download \"Urdu OCR\" (or import urd.traineddata). After that OCR reads Urdu automatically. Clear, printed text works best.
Settings > Models and OCR. You can import or download .tflite image models, .traineddata OCR data and .task chat models. Once installed, everything works offline.

While TalkBack is on, the app keeps its own voice off so the two do not speak together; TalkBack reads the result. If you prefer your own voice, turn on \"Speak results with my voice\" in Settings and pick an engine and voice under Voice (TTS).

• Service switch is dimmed: App info > three-dot menu > "Allow restricted settings".
• No Urdu voice: in Voice (TTS) press "Install voice data" or choose another engine such as Google.
• Screen is not described: Android 11 or newer is required, and protected screens (banking) block screenshots.
• Button is missing: Settings > Floating button > move it to "middle right".
All analysis happens on the phone. History contains text only and you can delete it any time.
Baseerat version %1$s\nAn offline vision assistant for blind and low-vision users, built on ML Kit and Tesseract.
List all buttons on the screen
There is no result to repeat yet.
Turn the service on (opens the system page)
The service was turned off. Press \"Turn the service on\" to start it again.

The \"Shortcut\" switch on the system accessibility page is optional: it is only a quick way to switch the service on or off. The floating button, volume buttons and tile work without it; only the main service switch (\"Use Baseerat\") must be on. If you cannot see that switch on the system page, use the button above, or turn the service on from this screen.

For each volume button choose what pressing it twice and holding it does. A button set to \"Nothing\" keeps working as a normal volume key. If a hold action is chosen, that key no longer changes the volume continuously.
Restore the volume after a gesture
The first press still changes the system volume by one step; this puts it back automatically.
Language of picture descriptions, answers to questions, chat replies and the spoken result. It can differ from the app language.
Ask the AI model anything, or show it a picture and talk about it.
Reading Urdu text needs the Urdu OCR data (one-time, a few MB).
Ask me anything. Add a picture and I can talk about it too (I only know what the picture detector found: objects, people, colors, text).
A picture is attached. Ask about it now.
Loading the chat model (the first time takes a while)…
No chat model is installed. Download or import one in Settings > Models and OCR. After attaching a picture you can still ask basic questions (objects, text, colors, people).
This build does not include the chat engine, so conversation is not possible. After attaching a picture you can still ask basic questions.
This build has no chat engine (see BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS). Only basic picture questions work.
The answer could not be made: %1$s
The model gave no answer. Please try again.
Chat uses small models in .task format (for example Qwen2.5, Gemma). They are 0.5 to 2 GB and need 1-3 GB of RAM while running. Urdu quality depends on the model (Gemma is usually better).
This build does not include the chat engine (MediaPipe). Chat models can be downloaded but will not run.
Chat models can be found here. Gemma needs a free licence acceptance in the browser; download the file and import it above.
About 0.5 GB. Simple conversation; limited Urdu. The link may change.
About 1.5 GB. Better answers, needs more RAM. The link may change.

Home and Settings > Floating button have \"Turn the service on\" (opens the system page of Baseerat) and \"Turn the service off\". The \"Shortcut\" switch in the system page is optional and only toggles the service quickly; you do not need it for the floating button or volume buttons.

Open the Chat tab to talk to an offline AI model. Add a picture (camera or gallery, or \"Chat about this picture\" on the result screen) and ask about it. First install a chat model in Settings > Models and OCR. Replies come in the AI response language you chose in Settings.
